GLIDESLOPE− Provides vertical guidance for aircraft during approach and landing.
PCG G−1

GROUND DELAY PROGRAM (GDP)− A traffic management process administered by the ATCSCC, when aircraft are held on the ground.
GROUND SPEED− The speed of an aircraft relative to the surface of the earth.
GROUND STOP (GS)− The GS is a process that requires aircraft that meet a specific criteria to remain on the ground.
GROUND VISIBILITY− See visibility.
PCG G−3
